body:
Does it even work for

```
Assert.That('A', Is.EqualTo('a').IgnoreCase);
```

Charlie
 On Jan 31, 2014 1:34 AM, "Rob Prouse" notifications@github.com wrote:

> While investigating issue #70https://github.com/nunit/nunit-framework/issues/70,
> I noticed that IgnoreCase is also not respected for any collections
> containing chars. For example, I would expect that the following would pass.
> 
> Assert.That( new[] {'A', 'B', 'C'}, Is.EqualTo( new [] {'a', 'b',
> 'c'}).IgnoreCase );
> 
> ## 
> 
> Reply to this email directly or view it on GitHubhttps://github.com/nunit/nunit-framework/issues/90
> .
